p: thirtieth year: After that the book of the Law as found, which was the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah, so that twenty-five years after this book was found, Jeconiah was led away captive with Ezekiel and many of the people, who the first year later saw these visions.
Chebar: Which was a part of Euphrates so called.
God: That is, notable and excellent visions, so that it might be known, it was no natural dream but came from God.
hand of the LORD was there: That is, the spirit of prophecy, as in Eze 3:22,37:1.
whirlwind came out of the north: By this diversity of words he signifies the fearful judgment of God and the great afflictions that would come on Jerusalem.
four living beings: Which were the four Cherubims that represented the glory of God, as in Eze 11:22.
joined one to another: The wing of the one touched the wing of the other.
the face of a man: Every cherubim had four faces, the face of a man, and of a lion on the right side, and the face of a bullock and of an eagle on the left side.
returned as the appearance of a: That is, when they had executed God's will: for before they returned not till God had changed the state of things.
beryl: The Hebrew word is tarshish meaning that the colour was like the Cilician Sea, or a precious stone so called.
wings: Which declared the swiftness and the fearfulness of God's judgments.
let down their wings: Which signified that they had no power of themselves, but only waited to execute God's commandment.
around within it: By which was signified a terrible judgment toward the earth.
upon my face: Considering the majesty of God, and the weakness of flesh.
